quantity: shell-separated occupation-one union-bound margin in bits

memory_schedule.formula: M(k)=ceil(log2(k))+2 for evaluated powers of two

probability_space.structured_outer: one fixed authenticated constituent reused in every row
probability_space.random_outer: one uniform full-rank [B,B/2] constituent sampled once and reused in every row
probability_space.routing: independent uniform row-coordinate and transposed-region permutations
probability_space.inner: independent RandomStepConv maps sampled once and shared by all messages

coverage.bch_stop: no authenticated complete rate-half BCH-derived spectrum is available at block length 256 or above
coverage.rm_stop: the next rate-half RM member after length 512 is RM(5,11) at length 2048, beyond the requested cap

limitations: These curves cover occupation one only and are not full distance-certificate margins.
Nearest binary64 arithmetic is not outward rounded.
The finite tilt grid supplies candidate witnesses and is not asserted optimal.
Random curves average over the one sampled constituent; they do not certify that a particular sampled constituent realizes the average spectrum.
